## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(here)
source(here("setup.R"))
source(here("functions", "data_cleaners.R"))
source(here("functions", "lfs_panel.R"))
source(here("functions", "construct_variables.R"))
```

## Prep Data
```{r}
panel06_26 <- build_residence_quarter_panel(
  here("data", "quarterly_lfs_raw"),
  from_year = 2006
)

panel06_26 %>% glimpse

panel06_26 <- read.csv("../data/processed/residence_quarter_panel_full.csv") %>% glimpse
```

## Construct Variables
```{r}
panel_file <- here("data", "processed", "residence_quarter_panel_full.csv")
if (!file.exists(panel_file)) {
  stop("Cannot find ", panel_file, ". Run pipeline/01_prep_data.R first.")
}

panel <- readr::read_csv(panel_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
vars <- construct_variables(panel)

vars %>% glimpse
```

## Main Regressions
```{r}
df <- read_csv("../data/processed/residence_quarter_regression.csv") %>% 
  filter(year>2021) %>%
  glimpse

```
```{r}
model1 <- feols(d_qoq_mean_log_hourpay_uk_born ~ d_qoq_mean_age_uk_born + d_qoq_share_uk_degree + d_qoq_share_uk_black| year |
                  d_qoq_ratio_migrant ~ d_qoq_national_ratio_migrant:baseline_ratio_migrant,
                data = df, vcov = ~residence
                )
etable(model1, stage = 1:2)
```

```{r}
model1 <- feols(d_qoq_mean_log_hourpay_uk_born ~ mean_age_uk_born + share_uk_degree + share_uk_black| year |
                  d_qoq_ratio_migrant ~ d_qoq_national_ratio_migrant:baseline_ratio_migrant,
                data = df, vcov = ~residence
                )
etable(model1, stage = 1:2)
```

## Quarterly regressions

The sample is `year > 2020`. Fixed effects stay residence and quarter. COVID controls are the 2020 age-standardised mortality rate interacted with year, with 2021 omitted, added after ethnicity and before education. In the 2SLS chunks, `etable` prints both stages and the first-stage F and Wald tests (`ivf` and `ivwald`).

```{r quarterly-sample}
q_file <- here("data", "processed", "residence_quarter_regression.csv")
if (!file.exists(q_file)) {
  stop("Cannot find ", q_file, ". Run pipeline/02_construct_variables.R first.")
}
q_reg <- read_csv(q_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(year > 2020) %>%
  filter(if_all(
    all_of(c(
      "d_qoq_mean_log_hourpay_uk_born", "residence", "period",
      "d_qoq_ratio_migrant", "shift_share_qoq_migrant",
      "d_qoq_ratio_eu", "d_qoq_ratio_non_eu",
      "shift_share_qoq_eu", "shift_share_qoq_non_eu",
      "d_qoq_share_uk_asian", "d_qoq_share_uk_black",
      "d_qoq_share_uk_chinese", "d_qoq_share_uk_eth_other",
      "d_qoq_share_uk_degree", "d_qoq_share_uk_low_qual",
      "d_qoq_mean_age_uk_born"
    )),
    ~ !is.na(.)
  )) %>%
  mutate(residence = as.character(residence), year = as.integer(year))

covid <- read_csv(here("data", "processed", "ons_covid_by_area_20.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(
    residence = as.character(residence),
    covid_asmr_2020 = as.numeric(covid_asmr_2020)
  )
if (anyDuplicated(covid$residence) > 0L || any(!is.finite(covid$covid_asmr_2020))) {
  stop("COVID file must have one finite 2020 rate per residence.")
}
n_before <- nrow(q_reg)
q_reg <- left_join(q_reg, covid, by = "residence")
if (nrow(q_reg) != n_before) {
  stop("COVID join changed the row count.")
}
if (any(!is.finite(q_reg$covid_asmr_2020))) {
  stop("A residence has no 2020 COVID rate.")
}
if (n_distinct(q_reg$residence) != 20L || min(q_reg$year) != 2021L) {
  stop("Estimation sample must be all 20 residences from 2021 onward.")
}
if (n_distinct(q_reg$residence[q_reg$year == 2021L]) != n_distinct(q_reg$residence)) {
  stop("2021 is missing for a residence, so it cannot be the omitted COVID year.")
}
q_reg <- q_reg %>%
  mutate(
    covid_asmr_2020_y2022 = covid_asmr_2020 * (year == 2022),
    covid_asmr_2020_y2023 = covid_asmr_2020 * (year == 2023),
    covid_asmr_2020_y2024 = covid_asmr_2020 * (year == 2024),
    covid_asmr_2020_y2025 = covid_asmr_2020 * (year == 2025),
    covid_asmr_2020_y2026 = covid_asmr_2020 * (year == 2026)
  )
nrow(q_reg)
```

## Quarterly pooled

The endogenous variable is `d_qoq_ratio_migrant`. The instrument is `shift_share_qoq_migrant`.

### Step 0 OLS, no controls

```{r q-pool-ols-0}
model_q_pool_ols_0 <- feols(
  d_qoq_mean_log_hourpay_uk_born ~ d_qoq_ratio_migrant,
  data = q_reg,
  vcov = ~residence
)
etable(model_q_pool_ols_0)
```

### Step 0 2SLS, no controls

```{r q-pool-iv-0}
model_q_pool_iv_0 <- feols(
  d_qoq_mean_log_hourpay_uk_born ~ 1 |
    d_qoq_ratio_migrant ~ shift_share_qoq_migrant,
  data = q_reg,
  vcov = ~residence
)
etable(model_q_pool_iv_0, fitstat = ~ . + ivf + ivwald, stage = 1:2)
```

### Step 1 OLS, residence and quarter fixed effects

```{r q-pool-ols-1}
model_q_pool_ols_1 <- feols(
  d_qoq_mean_log_hourpay_uk_born ~ d_qoq_ratio_migrant | residence + period,
  data = q_reg,
  vcov = ~residence
)
etable(model_q_pool_ols_1)
```

```{r q-pool-iv-1}
model_q_pool_iv_1 <- feols(

)
etable(model_q_pool_iv_1, fitstat = ~ . + ivf + ivwald, stage = 1:2)
```

### Step 5 2SLS, inclusive national migrant shift

`shift_share_qoq_migrant` is the 2017–2019 baseline times the quarter-to-quarter change in the leave-one-out national migrant ratio. Here the shift is `d_qoq_national_ratio_migrant`, the same change in the national migrant ratio with every residence included. The outcome, controls, fixed effects, sample, and clustering match the step 5 2SLS above.

```{r q-pool-iv-5-inclusive}
if (!all(c("baseline_ratio_migrant", "d_qoq_national_ratio_migrant") %in% names(q_reg))) {
  stop("q_reg needs baseline_ratio_migrant and d_qoq_national_ratio_migrant.")
}
q_inclusive <- q_reg %>%
  mutate(
    shift_share_qoq_migrant_inclusive =
      baseline_ratio_migrant * d_qoq_national_ratio_migrant
  )
if (any(!is.finite(q_inclusive$shift_share_qoq_migrant_inclusive))) {
  stop("Inclusive shift-share is missing on a step 5 row.")
}
model_q_pool_iv_5_inclusive <- feols(
  d_qoq_mean_log_hourpay_uk_born ~
    d_qoq_share_uk_asian + d_qoq_share_uk_black + d_qoq_share_uk_chinese + d_qoq_share_uk_eth_other +
    covid_asmr_2020_y2022 + covid_asmr_2020_y2023 + covid_asmr_2020_y2024 + covid_asmr_2020_y2025 + covid_asmr_2020_y2026 +
    d_qoq_share_uk_degree + d_qoq_share_uk_low_qual +
    d_qoq_mean_age_uk_born |
    residence + period |
    d_qoq_ratio_migrant ~ shift_share_qoq_migrant_inclusive,
  data = q_inclusive,
  vcov = ~residence
)
etable(model_q_pool_iv_5_inclusive, fitstat = ~ . + ivf + ivwald, stage = 1:2)
```

### Step 5 2SLS, population-weighted leave-one-out shift

`shift_share_qoq_migrant` multiplies the 2017–2019 baseline by the quarter-to-quarter change in the other residences' pooled migrant stock over their pooled native stock. This chunk builds the leave-one-out change as the average of the other residences' own quarter-to-quarter migrant-ratio changes, weighted by each residence's population in that quarter. Population is `pop` on the residence-quarter panel: the person-weighted count of residents aged 16–64, with unknown birthplace included. The instrument is the baseline times that average. The outcome, controls, fixed effects, sample, and clustering match the step 5 2SLS.

```{r q-pool-iv-5-loo-pop}
panel_pop <- read_csv(
  here("data", "processed", "residence_quarter_panel_full.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(
    residence = as.character(residence),
    year = as.integer(year),
    quarter = as.integer(quarter),
    pop = as.numeric(pop)
  )
if (anyDuplicated(panel_pop[c("residence", "year", "quarter")]) > 0L) {
  stop("Duplicate residence-quarter rows in the panel population.")
}
if (any(!is.finite(panel_pop$pop) | panel_pop$pop <= 0)) {
  stop("Population must be finite and positive.")
}
ratio_changes <- read_csv(
  here("data", "processed", "residence_quarter_regression.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  transmute(
    residence = as.character(residence),
    year = as.integer(year),
    quarter = as.integer(quarter),
    d_qoq_ratio_migrant = as.numeric(d_qoq_ratio_migrant)
  ) %>%
  left_join(panel_pop, by = c("residence", "year", "quarter"))
if (any(!is.finite(ratio_changes$pop))) {
  stop("A residence-quarter is missing population.")
}
loo_pop <- ratio_changes %>%
  group_by(year, quarter) %>%
  mutate(
    n_areas = n(),
    n_finite = sum(is.finite(d_qoq_ratio_migrant)),
    d_loo_ratio_migrant_pop =
      (sum(pop_uk_born * d_qoq_ratio_migrant) - pop * d_qoq_ratio_migrant) /
      (sum(pop) - pop)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(residence, year, quarter, n_areas, n_finite, d_loo_ratio_migrant_pop)
q_loo_pop <- q_reg %>%
  mutate(quarter = as.integer(quarter)) %>%
  left_join(loo_pop, by = c("residence", "year", "quarter")) %>%
  mutate(
    shift_share_qoq_migrant_loo_pop =
      baseline_ratio_migrant * d_loo_ratio_migrant_pop
  )
if (nrow(q_loo_pop) != nrow(q_reg)) {
  stop("Population-weighted leave-one-out join changed the row count.")
}
if (any(q_loo_pop$n_areas != 20L | q_loo_pop$n_finite != 20L)) {
  stop("A step 5 quarter does not have a finite migrant-ratio change for all 20 residences.")
}
if (any(!is.finite(q_loo_pop$shift_share_qoq_migrant_loo_pop))) {
  stop("Population-weighted leave-one-out shift-share is missing on a step 5 row.")
}
model_q_pool_iv_5_loo_pop <- feols(
  d_qoq_mean_log_hourpay_uk_born ~
    d_qoq_share_uk_asian + d_qoq_share_uk_black + d_qoq_share_uk_chinese + d_qoq_share_uk_eth_other +
    covid_asmr_2020_y2022 + covid_asmr_2020_y2023 + covid_asmr_2020_y2024 + covid_asmr_2020_y2025 + covid_asmr_2020_y2026 +
    d_qoq_share_uk_degree + d_qoq_share_uk_low_qual +
    d_qoq_mean_age_uk_born |
    residence + period |
    d_qoq_ratio_migrant ~ shift_share_qoq_migrant_loo_pop,
  data = q_loo_pop,
  vcov = ~residence
)
etable(model_q_pool_iv_5_loo_pop, fitstat = ~ . + ivf + ivwald, stage = 1:2)
```

## Quarterly EU and non-EU

The endogenous variables are `d_qoq_ratio_eu` and `d_qoq_ratio_non_eu`. The instruments are `shift_share_qoq_eu` and `shift_share_qoq_non_eu`.

### Step 0 OLS, no controls

```{r q-eu-ols-0}
model_q_eu_ols_0 <- feols(
  d_qoq_mean_log_hourpay_uk_born ~ d_qoq_ratio_eu + d_qoq_ratio_non_eu,
  data = q_reg,
  vcov = ~residence
)
etable(model_q_eu_ols_0)
```

### Step 0 2SLS, no controls

```{r q-eu-iv-0}

)
```

## Annual regressions

The sample is `year > 2020` on complete calendar years. `period` is the calendar year. `d_annual_*_l1` is left out. COVID controls are the 2020 age-standardised mortality rate interacted with year, with 2021 omitted, added after ethnicity and before education. The interactions stop at 2025 because 2026 is not a complete year. In the 2SLS chunks, `etable` prints both stages and the first-stage F and Wald tests (`ivf` and `ivwald`).

```{r annual-sample}
a_file <- here("data", "processed", "residence_annual_regression.csv")
if (!file.exists(a_file)) {
  stop(
    "Cannot find ", a_file,
    ". Run pipeline/02_construct_annual_variables.R first."
  )
}
a_reg <- read_csv(a_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(year > 2020) %>%
  filter(if_all(
    all_of(c(
      "d_annual_mean_log_hourpay_uk_born", "residence", "year", "period",
      "d_annual_ratio_migrant", "shift_share_annual_migrant",
      "d_annual_ratio_eu", "d_annual_ratio_non_eu",
      "shift_share_annual_eu", "shift_share_annual_non_eu",
      "d_annual_share_uk_asian", "d_annual_share_uk_black",
      "d_annual_share_uk_chinese", "d_annual_share_uk_eth_other",
      "d_annual_share_uk_degree", "d_annual_share_uk_low_qual",
      "d_annual_mean_age_uk_born"
    )),
    ~ !is.na(.)
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    residence = as.character(residence),
    year = as.integer(year),
    period = as.character(year)
  )

covid <- read_csv(here("data", "processed", "ons_covid_by_area_20.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(
    residence = as.character(residence),
    covid_asmr_2020 = as.numeric(covid_asmr_2020)
  )
if (anyDuplicated(covid$residence) > 0L || any(!is.finite(covid$covid_asmr_2020))) {
  stop("COVID file must have one finite 2020 rate per residence.")
}
n_before <- nrow(a_reg)
a_reg <- left_join(a_reg, covid, by = "residence")
if (nrow(a_reg) != n_before) {
  stop("COVID join changed the row count.")
}
if (any(!is.finite(a_reg$covid_asmr_2020))) {
  stop("A residence has no 2020 COVID rate.")
}
if (n_distinct(a_reg$residence) != 20L || min(a_reg$year) != 2021L) {
  stop("Estimation sample must be all 20 residences from 2021 onward.")
}
if (n_distinct(a_reg$residence[a_reg$year == 2021L]) != n_distinct(a_reg$residence)) {
  stop("2021 is missing for a residence, so it cannot be the omitted COVID year.")
}
a_reg <- a_reg %>%
  mutate(
    covid_asmr_2020_y2022 = covid_asmr_2020 * (year == 2022),
    covid_asmr_2020_y2023 = covid_asmr_2020 * (year == 2023),
    covid_asmr_2020_y2024 = covid_asmr_2020 * (year == 2024),
    covid_asmr_2020_y2025 = covid_asmr_2020 * (year == 2025)
  )
nrow(a_reg)
```

## Annual pooled

The endogenous variable is `d_annual_ratio_migrant`. The instrument is `shift_share_annual_migrant`.

### Step 0 OLS, no controls

```{r a-pool-ols-0}
model_a_pool_ols_0 <- feols(
  d_annual_mean_log_hourpay_uk_born ~ d_annual_ratio_migrant,
  data = a_reg,
  vcov = ~residence
)
etable(model_a_pool_ols_0)
```
